text:
git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
fix(output): `echo` on an `iterable` parameter converted an array in SILENCE

php raises `Array to string conversion` at every site that turns an array into
a string, and `echo $items` inside `function show(iterable $items)` is one of
them: MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6, two calls raise two warnings, each naming the
line of the `echo` itself rather than either call site.

elephc printed `Array` and said nothing. Everything needed was already in
place — the EIR instruction admitted `may_warn`, the backend published the line
for it, and the runtime writer had already dispatched on the heap kind and knew
it was looking at an array. That arm just never raised the diagnostic, while the
`echo $array` spelling one line away did, through an entirely different path.

The warning belongs in the runtime writer because only the runtime knows the
kind: the same helper serves payloads that print nothing at all. Both arches,
mirroring the boxed-Mixed writer that had already been given this exact fix.

The test pinning `"Array|Array|Arraydone"` had been failing since the local-array
half started warning. It now asserts the whole php-identical shape: three
warnings, two at the `echo`'s line and one at the local's.
